_guide: Wonders: sights worth seeing. Each one unlocks the first time you find a world that matches it, and shows on the
Ship page, under Achievements. (Solving a mystery gives a Wonder too: that's written in mysteries.json.)
One entry each: id (lowercase, never reused), ic (an emoji), name, desc (shown as a hint before you've seen it), when:
type ("Ocean"), rarity, star ("binary pair"), rings (true), moons, lifeLvl (0 to 6), temp (degrees C), hab (0 to 100),
water (percent), gravity (in g), weatherWords and biomeWords (single words from the weather or biomes, like "glass").
Numbers can be ">9" or "<0.3". Every key in when must match.
